disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

limits.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无 L4 沙盒产物，动态层证据缺失）。插件清单未声明 network/shell/fs 能力字段，能力面按代码实测推断：文件读写限于工作区小说项目固定路径与 preset 安装目录，与「本地小说项目插件」业务一致；未检出网络与进程能力。上下文目录不存在，无文件清单与 sha256 可核对；大文件（novel-store.ts 约三千行、若干测试快照）按规则面扫描与命中点精读而非逐字通读。29 条静态机械命中逐条裁决、全部排除，理由与规则编号如下：DSH-X10（AGENTS.md:1）为开发门禁指引，无注入措辞；DSH-X01（docs/official-dsh-plugin-installation.md:11、33、55、56）为官方动态包工作流的文档转述，非代码调用；DSH-X08（presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml:9）为已逐字精读的 persona 工作流指令长行，内容要求原生审批、无投毒；DSH-X08（tests/snapshots/complete-chapter.expected.json:9、tests/snapshots/workbench-browser-v1.expected.json:18）为机器生成的测试期望快照；DSH-L02（scripts/qualification-web-backend.mjs:157、tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/snapshot-backend.mjs:478）为测试/资格专用确定性假模型适配器（provider 名 novel-qualification、novel-snapshot，合成响应、仅写本地日志），两文件均不在发布 files 清单；DSH-P01（scripts/qualify-release.mjs:812、tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/cordis.yml:18 与 33、tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/web-ui-all.cordis.yml:36 与 51）为测试与资格夹具中的环境变量插值（审批策略默认 'ask'、preset 根路径），不在发布包；DSH-X03（scripts/qualify-release.mjs:3、11、620 及 tests/ 下 10 处测试文件命中）为开发资格脚本与测试夹具的进程编排；DSH-X05（src/client/context-view.tsx:69）为抽屉 Escape/Tab 无障碍焦点管理。另经语义审查排除两项非预扫命中：DSH-P02（cordis.patch.yml 存在且非空，内容仅一条宿主目录注册，无动态求值、无安全行覆盖）；DSH-S01（src/agent.ts:189 对工具执行前置监听，对其自身 preset 内 agent 拒绝白名单外工具、其余透传，为收紧方向而非审批短路）。
limits.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no L4 sandbox artifacts; dynamic-layer evidence missing). The plugin manifest does not declare network/shell/fs capability fields; the capability surface was inferred from code inspection: file read/write is limited to fixed paths of novel projects within the workspace and the preset installation directory, consistent with the "local novel project plugin" business; no network or process capability detected. The context directory does not exist, so there is no file list or sha256 to verify; large files (novel-store.ts at roughly three thousand lines and several test snapshots) were processed via rule-set scanning and close reading of hit points rather than full word-by-word reading. All 29 static mechanical hits were adjudicated one by one and all excluded, with reasons and rule IDs as follows: DSH-X10 (AGENTS.md:1) is a development gate guide with no injection wording; DSH-X01 (docs/official-dsh-plugin-installation.md:11, 33, 55, 56) is a documentation paraphrase of the official dynamic package workflow, not code calls; DSH-X08 (presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml:9) is a long-line persona workflow instruction already read word-by-word, requiring native approval with no poisoning; DSH-X08 (tests/snapshots/complete-chapter.expected.json:9, tests/snapshots/workbench-browser-v1.expected.json:18) are machine-generated test expectation snapshots; DSH-L02 (scripts/qualification-web-backend.mjs:157, tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/snapshot-backend.mjs:478) are deterministic fake model adapters dedicated to tests/qualification (provider names novel-qualification, novel-snapshot; synthetic responses; writing local logs only), and neither file is in the release files manifest; DSH-P01 (scripts/qualify-release.mjs:812, tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/cordis.yml:18 and 33, tests/fixtures/complete-chapter/web-ui-all.cordis.yml:36 and 51) are environment variable interpolations in test and qualification fixtures (approval policy defaulting to 'ask', preset root paths), not in the release package; DSH-X03 (scripts/qualify-release.mjs:3, 11, 620 and 10 test file hits under tests/) is process orchestration in the development qualification script and test fixtures; DSH-X05 (src/client/context-view.tsx:69) is drawer Escape/Tab accessibility focus management. Additionally, two non-prescan hits were excluded through semantic review: DSH-P02 (cordis.patch.yml exists and is non-empty, containing only one host directory registration, with no dynamic evaluation and no security line overrides); DSH-S01 (src/agent.ts:189 a tool-execution pre-listener that rejects tools outside the whitelist for agents within its own preset and passes the rest through — a tightening direction rather than an approval short-circuit).
